victorTardieu.title: Victor Tardieu Award
victorTardieu.description: Born in the context of celebrating a century of tradition of the Indochina School of Fine Arts - Vietnam University of Fine Arts, the Victor Tardieu Award carries the spirit of 'A century of convergence, opening the future'. The award is named after Victor Tardieu - a French painter and the first principal of the Indochina School of Fine Arts, who laid the foundation for modern art education in Vietnam.

mandarineRoad.title: Mandarine Road Prize
mandarineRoad.description: The Mandarine Road Prize competition is officially launched! The 'Mandarine Road Prize' (Prix de la route Mandarine) is organized annually with the aim of honoring two Vietnamese students majoring in fine arts, helping them take their first steps into the international art market through an exhibition in Paris.
